note: Loudon County and its cities publish zoning maps only as static PDFs (county 2007 zoning map, Greenback, Philadelphia); the city links to the state Tennessee Property Viewer, which shows no zoning service. The county's ArcGIS web map (LoudonTN_Layers, LoudonTN_DynBase on utility.arcgis.com) is token-protected ('Error generating token'), so no queryable public zoning layer was found after searching ArcGIS Online/Hub and the county, city and assessor sites.
